CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

MAYOR OF BLITAR,

Considering:
a. that every citizen has the right to be free from torture, discrimination or treatment that degrades human dignity and has the right to obtain security and freedom from all forms of violence; b. that women and children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, therefore they need to receive legal Protection; c. that based on the provisions in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015, women's empowerment and child protection are governmental affairs that must be implemented by Regional Governments; d. that the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Blitar City has not been optimal, therefore institutional strengthening and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation in accordance with applicable provisions; e. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c and letter d, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; In View of:
1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; 2. Law Number 17 of 1950 concerning the Establishment of Small City Regions within the Province of East Java, Central Java and West Java (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1950 Number 42) as amended by Law Number 13 of 1954 concerning Amendment to Law Number 16 and Number 17 of 1950 (Former Republic of Indonesia) Concerning the Establishment of Large Cities and Small Cities in Java (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1954 Number 40, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 551); 3. Law Number 4 of 1979 concerning Child Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1979 Number 32, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 3143); 4. Law Number 7 of 1984 concerning Ratification of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1984 Number 29, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 3668); 5. Law Number 39 of 1999 concerning Human Rights (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1999 Number 165, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia 3886); 6. Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2002 Number 109, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3143); as amended by Law Number 35 of 2014 concerning Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 297, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5606); 7. Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 95, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4419); 8. Law Number 13 of 2006 concerning Protection of Witnesses and Victims (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2006 Number 64, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4635); 9. Law Number 21 of 2007 concerning Eradication of the Criminal Act of Trafficking in Persons (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2007 Number 58, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4720); 10. Law Number 11 of 2009 concerning Social Welfare (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2009 Number 12, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4976); 11. Law Number 12 of 2011 concerning Formation of Legislation (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2011 Number 82, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5234); 12. Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 244 Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015 concerning Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2015 Number 58 Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5679); 13. Government Regulation Number 48 of 1982 concerning Amendment to the Territorial Boundaries of the Second Level Municipality Region of Blitar (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1982 Number 75, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3243); 14. Government Regulation Number 4 of 2006 concerning Implementation and Cooperation for Recovery of Victims of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2006 Number 15, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia number 64); 15. Presidential Regulation Number 87 of 2014 concerning Implementing Regulations of Law Number 12 of 2011 concerning Formation of Legislation (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 199); 16. Regulation of the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 2 of 2008 concerning Implementation of Women's Protection; 16. Regulation of the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 3 of 2008 concerning Implementation of Child Protection; 17. Regulation of the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection of the Republic of Indonesia Number 1 of 2010 concerning Minimum Service Standards (SPM) in the Field of Integrated Services for Women and Children Victims of Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2010 Number 56); 18. Regulation of the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 5 of 2010 concerning Guidelines for Establishment and Development of Integrated Service Centers; 19.

Article 15

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 12 letters c and d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 29

Guidance and supervision as referred to in Article 28 paragraph (2) and paragraph (3), are conducted in order to realize the objectives of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence in accordance with minimum service standards established by laws and regulations.

Article 32

1. The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations and universities that implement protection for women and children victims of violence.
2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity.

Article 27

1. The safe house as referred to in Article 26 paragraph (1), provides a temporary safe place and/or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.
2. The operation and/or management of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
3. For security and at the request of victims of violence, the manager or operator of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (2) may place victims of violence in a certain confidential location.
4. Further provisions regarding the operation of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (2) are further regulated in a Mayor Regulation.

Part Seven

Protection

Article 5

Physical violence as referred to in Article 4 letter a includes acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and/or cause death.

Article 26

1. In the event that victims of violence require continuous handling, they have the right to stay in a safe house or alternative residence. (2) Continuous handling as referred to in paragraph (1), constitutes handling at the rehabilitation stage carried out either by individuals, groups or Government and non-Government institutions.

CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Article 30

1. P2TP2A reports the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence to the Mayor.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) is submitted in writing, including:a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; andd. performance.
3. Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2), is implemented every 3 (three) months.
4. Reporting procedures as referred to in paragraph (1), are further regulated in a Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

MAYOR OF BLITAR,

Considering:
a. that every citizen has the right to be free from torture, discrimination or treatment that degrades human dignity and has the right to obtain security and freedom from all forms of violence; b. that women and children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, therefore they need to receive legal Protection; c. that based on the provisions in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015, women's empowerment and child protection are governmental affairs that must be implemented by Regional Governments; d. that the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Blitar City has not been optimal, therefore institutional strengthening and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation in accordance with applicable provisions; e. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c and letter d, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; In View of:

19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.

27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 29

Guidance and supervision as referred to in Article 28 paragraph (2) and paragraph (3), are conducted in order to realize the objectives of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence in accordance with minimum service standards established by laws and regulations.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 26

(2) Continuous handling as referred to in paragraph (1), constitutes handling at the rehabilitation stage carried out either by individuals, groups or Government and non-Government institutions.

Article 27

1. The safe house as referred to in Article 26 paragraph (1), provides a temporary safe place and/or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.
2. The operation and/or management of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 26

1. In the event that victims of violence require continuous handling, they have the right to stay in a safe house or alternative residence. (2) Continuous handling as referred to in paragraph (1), constitutes handling at the rehabilitation stage carried out either by individuals, groups or Government and non-Government institutions.

Article 27

1. The safe house as referred to in Article 26 paragraph (1), provides a temporary safe place and/or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.
2. The operation and/or management of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
3. For security and at the request of victims of violence, the manager or operator of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (2) may place victims of violence in a certain confidential location.
4. Further provisions regarding the operation of the safe house as referred to in paragraph (2) are further regulated in a Mayor Regulation.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

Article 32

1. The Regional Government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations and universities that implement protection for women and children victims of violence.
2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity.

MAYOR OF BLITAR,

Considering:
a. that every citizen has the right to be free from torture, discrimination or treatment that degrades human dignity and has the right to obtain security and freedom from all forms of violence; b. that women and children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, therefore they need to receive legal Protection; c. that based on the provisions in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015, women's empowerment and child protection are governmental affairs that must be implemented by Regional Governments; d. that the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Blitar City has not been optimal, therefore institutional strengthening and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation in accordance with applicable provisions; e. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c and letter d, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; In View of:

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.

MAYOR OF BLITAR,

a. that every citizen has the right to be free from torture, discrimination or treatment that degrades human dignity and has the right to obtain security and freedom from all forms of violence; b. that women and children are vulnerable groups who tend to experience Violence, therefore they need to receive legal Protection; c. that based on the provisions in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as amended several times most recently by Law Number 9 of 2015, women's empowerment and child protection are governmental affairs that must be implemented by Regional Governments; d. that the implementation of Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence in Blitar City has not been optimal, therefore institutional strengthening and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation in accordance with applicable provisions; e. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c and letter d, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence; In View of:

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is the City of Blitar.
2. Regional Government is the Government of the City of Blitar.
3. Mayor is the Mayor of Blitar.
4. Regional apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Mayor and the Regional House of Representatives in the administration of governmental affairs that are the authority of the region.
5. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child in the womb.
6. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
7. Prevention is an activity carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
8. Protection is all efforts aimed at providing a sense of security to victims carried out by family, community, advocates, social institutions, police, prosecutors, courts, or other parties either temporarily.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Physical violence is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
11. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
12. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwanted with another person for commercial purposes and/or certain purposes.
13. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
14. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.
15. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
16. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
17. Service is an activity and immediate action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
18. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-empowerment of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
19. Repatriation is an effort to return women and child victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfill their needs.
20. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in the community.
21. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with families, communities, institutions, or other social environments that can provide protection.
22. Institution is an agency/office/body/office within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organizations that provide assistance.
23. Counseling is the provision of assistance by an expert/trained person in such a way that the psychological understanding and ability of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.
24. Integrated Service Unit hereinafter abbreviated as UPT is technical service units in the Region that carry out integrated service functions for women and child victims of crime and/or violence, including as a center for information on women's empowerment and child protection.
25. Integrated Service Center for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is a form of UPT established by the Regional Government that functions as an information center, service center and empowerment center for women and children.
26. Regional Action Plan is a foundation and guideline for related agencies, vertical agencies, and the community, in order to carry out activities for the prevention and protection of women and child victims of violence.
27. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to provide protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
